title: Reporting verbs & complementation
note: Reporting verbs + that/to-inf/-ing/object patterns · precise complementation · thin shell 2026-08-06 · B2 reported speech advanced is foundation

cards.title: Not only said/told
cards.body: At C1 pick the **reporting verb and its pattern**: *admit doing*, *insist that*, *warn sb not to*, *suggest that/ing*, *accuse sb of*, *promise to*. Same idea, different grammar after the verb.
cards.body_cz: Na C1 volíte **reporting sloveso a vazbu**: admit doing, insist that, warn sb not to, suggest that/-ing…

accepts: She admitted to taking the file.

items.en: He insisted that we leave immediately.
items.cz: Trval na tom, abychom hned odešli.
accepts: He insisted that we leave immediately.
He insisted that we should leave immediately.

items.en: They warned us not to touch the wires.
items.cz: Varovali nás, abychom se nedotýkali drátů.
items.gap: They warned us not ____ touch the wires.
accepts: They warned us not to touch the wires.
She suggested that we postpone the meeting.

items.en: They promised to refund the money.
accepts: They promised to refund the money.

items.en: She denied having seen the email.
accepts: She denied having seen the email.

items.en: The report claims that costs have risen.
items.gap: The report claims that costs ____ risen.
accepts: The report claims that costs have risen.

items.en: I reminded him to lock the door.
items.cz: Připomněl jsem mu, aby zamkl dveře.
items.gap: I reminded him ____ lock the door.
accepts: I reminded him to lock the door.
